name: Nylidrin
summary: Buphenine, also known as nylidrin and sold under the brand name Arlidin, is a β2 adrenoreceptor agonist that acts as a vasodilator.

pharmacology.text: Buphenine, also known as nylidrin and sold under the brand name Arlidin, is a β2 adrenoreceptor agonist that acts as a vasodilator.

uses.text: Buphenine, also known as nylidrin and sold under the brand name Arlidin, is a β2 adrenoreceptor agonist that acts as a vasodilator. It was developed as a chemical derivative of oxilofrine, and first reported in the literature in 1950.

summaryZh: 布酚寧（英語：Buphenine，商品名：Arlidin）是一種含氮有機化合物，分子式C19H25NO2，為奧洛福林（甲基辛弗林）衍生物，可作為β2腎上腺素受體激動藥，能用做血管舒張藥物，1950年開發。
summaryZhHans: 布酚宁（英语：Buphenine，商品名：Arlidin）是一种含氮有机化合物，分子式C19H25NO2，为奥洛福林（甲基辛弗林）衍生物，可作为β2肾上腺素受体激动药，能用做血管舒张药物，1950年开发。
